title: Campus Transportation & Parking Lot Advisory
inputText:
CAMPUS SAFETY & TRANSPORTATION DEPARTMENT
General Circular: Parking Regulations for Fall Semester

All registered students, faculty, and campus visitors are reminded of the following campus vehicle guidelines:
- Student vehicles must display valid Lot-C decal on front windshield at all times.
- Campus speed limit is strictly enforced at 15 MPH.
- Overnight parking in Faculty Lot-A is strictly prohibited.
- Vehicles parked in fire lanes or handicap stalls without valid state permit will be towed at owner expense.

For visitor day passes, visit the campus security booth at Gate 1.
